gloss: knife skills; knife handling; knife technique

definitions.gloss: knife skills; knife handling; knife technique
definitions.explanation: A cook's skill at handling a kitchen knife — speed, precision, and control. Often used to praise the dexterity of a professional chef or a skilled home cook.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{包丁|ほうちょう}さばき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧だ。
examples.english: My mother has excellent knife skills.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧な{包丁|ほうちょう}さばき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}われた→奪う：01895_ubau⟧。
examples.english: I was transfixed by the brilliant knife work.

examples.japanese: ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理人|りょうりにん}→料理人：19396_ryourinin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{包丁|ほうちょう}さばき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧⟦{踊|おど}っている→踊る：01250_odoru⟧ようだった。
examples.english: The professional chef's knife handling was like a dance.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧ (kitchen knife) + さばき (handling, manipulation — from ⟦{捌|さば}く→捌く：27532_sabaku⟧). Always positive in connotation; almost always used to praise someone's cutting skill.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {包丁|ほうちょう}さばき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧: skilled with a knife
- ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{包丁|ほうちょう}さばき: impressive knife work
- ⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧な{包丁|ほうちょう}さばき: brilliant knife handling
- ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{包丁|ほうちょう}さばき: professional-level knife skills

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手|て}さばき→手さばき：30146_tesabaki⟧: hand technique — general dexterity, not just knife work
- ⟦{腕前|うでまえ}→腕前：07299_udemae⟧: skill level — broader; can apply to any craft
